mentions.name: basi
mentions.description: A web app testing tool with a simple-to-use syntax/DSL built on Playwright (Go), aimed at reducing the work of automated application testing. It includes a documentation generation feature that turns UI test steps into a markdown document with screenshots to help teams craft end-user documentation. Planned additions include Playwright/Cypress-style reports and support for running tests on remote browser instances for different workflows.
mentions.problem: Reduces the work required for automated testing of applications
mentions.audience: Teams doing automated testing of applications and crafting end-user documentation
